messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: inference-runtime high 5xx rate for production-west. Alert group: runtime-errors. See alerts (https://ops.redwood/alerts/AR-304999).
ashley_oncall: got it, I'm on the pager. Seeing spike at ~00:04 UTC, gateway 504s and runner 5xx from model-runner-3.
mike_ml: fyi I just saw a metric bump in KV cache misses + long tails on seq=2048 requests. Could be cache thrash causing OOM in the runner.
carla_sre: adding context — we've got a steady stream of segfault traces in syslog from the model container: "SIGSEGV at torch::native::..." across multiple hosts. Attaching excerpt below.
carla_sre: ```
[2026-03-15T00:04:21Z] host=gpu-12 runtime: segfault at 0x7f8a3... backtrace: model_runner+0x1f2a, ae_kernel+0x4b, python3.11
[2026-03-15T00:04:22Z] host=gpu-13 runtime: oom-killer invoked, killed java (model runner)
```
ashley_oncall: customers impacted? Checking dashboards... traffic drop to 60% of normal on west gateways. Error budget alert firing for several dev customers.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-304999 (severity: high). On-call: ashley_oncall. Handoff channel: #incidents.
leo_infra: quick check — autoscaler isn't launching new runner pods on west due to quota errors: "insufficient GPU quota" from cloud API. That explains why pods keep getting packed and OOM.
mike_ml: hypothesis: a combination of large-seq requests (>=2048) + continuous batching + prefix cache misses is increasing memory pressure. If a kernel fails we see segfaults and subsequent 5xx.
ashley_oncall: can we triage to a fallback model or reduce request size? We need immediate mitigation to lower 5xx. Suggestions?
carla_sre: two quick options: 1) Apply gateway rate-limit on seq>1024 requests and ramp down concurrency per-route (fast); 2) Switch routing policy to fallback_model: model-neo-3b-quant in west (slightly lower quality but much more stable).
leo_infra: I can push a routing override to send 20% of traffic to nearest region (eu-west) and 80% to the safe fallback in west. But moving cross-region might add latency.
mike_ml: prefer fallback in-region to preserve latency. We should also disable continuous-batching on model-runner-3 temporarily — batching 50->20 will reduce memory per-batch.
ashley_oncall: do it. leo, roll a traffic policy. carla, apply per-route concurrency cap of 8 and block seq>2048. mike, coordinate to disable batching on live runners.
leo_infra: rolling policy now: ```cheetahctl routing set --region west --policy override --fallback model-neo-3b-quant --split 80/20 --note "mitigate runtime segfaults"```
leo_infra: policy applied. Watch for errors to drop.
carla_sre: applying concurrency cap via gateway: ```PATCH /routes/serve/prod-west {"concurrency_limit":8, "max_sequence_length":2048}```
carla_sre: cap applied. Also added a short-rate-limit rule to throttle requests with prompt size > 8k tokens at 5rps.
mike_ml: disabling continuous-batching on runners (hot config) with rollout flag: `runner.config.batch_size=20`. Pushing now.
mike_ml: pushed config, rolling restart of a small subset of runner pods to pick up change.
ashley_oncall: initial signal: 30s after policies, 5xx reduced from 12% -> 5% but still elevated. Some segfaults persist on two hosts.
carla_sre: looking at core dumps — both hosts show the same failing kernel path in quant attention plugin. Might be a regression in the custom quant jit we rolled last week.
mike_ml: that aligns with the release notes — we shipped quant attention micro-optimizations on Mar 10. I'll open a quick rollback to the previous kernel variant.
leo_infra: note: we were at GPU quota — if rollback increases memory needs we might re-trigger eviction cascade. Monitor closely.
ashley_oncall: mike, do the rollback. carla, keep pressure caps in place until we confirm stability. leo, get cloud quota request in parallel.
mike_ml: rolling kernel rollback to v2026-03-08 (safe-quant). Command: `deployctl model-runner-3 --kernel-version safe-quant --graceful-restart`. Executing now.
mike_ml: rollback completed on 60% of runners; remainder rolling.
carla_sre: segfault logs decreasing. Error rate trending down to 1.2% over last 5m. Gateways show 99.2% traffic success in prod-west.
ashley_oncall: good. Customer impact: checked top 5 tenants — two experienced elevated latency and 10-20% error spikes for 6 minutes. No major SLA breaches yet but we should notify account teams.
ops-bot: INC-304999 status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Current severity: reduced.
leo_infra: quota request submitted (ticket Q-54233) to add 6 GPUs to west pool; pending approval ~45m.
mike_ml: action items I'll follow up: revert the quant jit PR in staging, add extra unit tests for attention kernels.
carla_sre: SRE action items: keep concurrency caps for 30m, remove rate-limit after 60m of stable 5xx<0.5%. Collect core dumps and attach to incident.
ashley_oncall: I'll draft customer comms for impacted tenants and ping AMs. Also will do a short postmortem sync in 2 hours.
ashley_oncall: closing loop here — marking thread as reduced but will keep incident open until full verification. :white_check_mark:
